serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone’s calling me… {{wi}}On the second phone…
The phone that I was given from these terrorists…
My heart skipped a bit when I realized what exactly was going on.
Is it the Admin calling me about the meeting? 
I have no time to think about this. If I don’t pick it up soon, the whole plan might fail. Myself and Big Daddy worked too hard for me to ruin everything like this.
This is my last chance…
You: Hello…
???: …
You: Is it you, Admin?
???: …
Why isn’t he answering? What’s going on?
???: You went and did something unnecessary.
That is the same guy who gave me all these missions.
What is he talking about?
You: Are you mad at me for some reason? I don’t understand…
???: I’m not the Admin, you fool. I can’t believe you didn’t realize that yet.
What?! But that’s the same voice that was guiding me through all these stupid missions! What’s going on?!
You: Then who are you?!
???: It’s not important right now. 
You: It isn’t?!
???: You are the one who asked me to give you a way to contact the Admin, I trusted you.
Is that Big Daddy’s doing? Gotta be.
???: Listen! {{wi}}Are you a real patriot or not?! If you are, you will listen…
What other choice do I have? One wrong move might blow my cover.
???: I will take your silence as a yes.
???: Answer me honestly. Do you really believe that the way Admin is doing things is the right one?
???: Hiding in the shadows like rats, developing some AI that is supposed to miraculously save us…{{wi}} Do you really think it’s the right way of doing things?
???: If we want to change this country for real, we need to take things into our own hands! We need to take action! Be merciless! Destroy our ENEMIES!
???: I know you think the same… 
…Do I?
???: After all, you finished all my missions. Even the sight of the gun didn’t faze you and I know you knew about it! You spent too much time with it to not know. I’m not stupid.
???: Listen.
???: I tried convincing Admin that we can’t realize our ambitions peacefully many times, but he’s a pacifist to the bone and he never listened to my pleas. 
???: So I started my own project. I call it People’s Insurgents Seeking Superintelligence. I picked out the most patriotic members and gave them missions that would really make a change! It was easy since I was in charge of the recent recruiting. 
???: We started big, with the attack on the member of the House. Later some minor sabotages and then was the anti-sexbot activist you probably know the most about.
So that was his idea?! Not Admin’s?! No…{{wi}} What he’s saying is that Admin doesn’t even know about this stuff!
Who exactly is this guy?!
???: Sooner or later Admin will realize what I’m doing and probably kick me out from the organization, but right now? I’m his right hand man. I was an easy pick since I have vast programming and cyber security knowledge second only to Admin in his organization.
???: Now the most important part.
???: Admin has a dead man’s switch. 
???: If he doesn’t input a code on his PC in time, all the access codes, everything, will be transferred to me. Even the coordinates of his base of operation.
???: If you agree with me, that we need to take matters into our own hands and stop believing in some AI that might be impossible to create, YOU! My comrade, will FINISH Admin…
He wants me to… kill Admin?
???: I’m not happy about doing this. I never wanted to be a leader, but Admin and his STUPID morals leave me no choice.
???: I’m the good guy here! I’m the only one ready to sacrifice EVERYTHING for his cause! 
???: If you want to change the world with me…
???: …I left the gun behind the garbage bin. In the same place you found this phone on which you are talking to me. 
A gun?!
Is this guy crazy?! Does he really think I’m going to do his dirty work?
I really want to call him names, but that wouldn’t be smart. I should keep my composure 
???: All you need to do is to kill Admin. If you do this, we will have a chance to change this world for real! {{wi}}I will even make you one of my generals after I take over.
???: Think about it, but don’t think too long. Admin told me he will be contacting you shortly…
???: Do you have any questions?
Too many. I have so many questions, but I can’t ask any! He could start suspecting me.
You: N-no, I don’t have any questions.
???: Ha! That’s what I wanted to hear. We need people that follow the orders without unnecessary talk.
???: I hope you are with me on this. Remember. I know where you live.
???: If you tell the Admin about my plans…{{wi}} I wouldn’t want to do something bad to a fellow patriot like you…
If I don’t kill Admin he’s going to kill me?!
I will need to contact Big Daddy as soon as this phone call is over. Otherwise, I’m cooked!
???: That's all I wanted to say. I hope you will make the right choice.
He hung up…
I have so many thoughts running through my mind. This guy revealing himself as the evil mastermind changed everything! 
If what he says is true, Admin is innocent! {{wi}}...well, he’s still conspiring to create an AI that will rule us all, but he wasn’t involved in those violent attacks! I don’t know what to think about it…
Maybe he and Big Daddy can join forces and together realize their common goals. 
I’m calling Big Daddy right now, there’s no time to lose.
You: Big Daddy! Something big just happened!
